Messages.Author: Mewcat
Messages.Body:
i was looking at hazimel recently and noticed something about his special ability. It will cost cross table allies 2 blood to attempt to remove pentex or to attempt to rescue him. Since there is no end in sight to the pentex meta an 11 cap that is VERY weak to pentex qualifies as a special disability.

Can we get any confirmation on the design intent for Hazimel? Was it intended to be a special disability? The overall capacity, discipline spread, and other abilities suggest it was intended to be a positive effect.

PS - what is your best argument for your cross table to remove pentex?

Can I get some help with pentex? I will giants blood you next turn.

Messages.Author: DJHedgehog
Messages.Body:
Someone won a 10 player tournament with Hazimel allstar deck in 2018. Clearly you don't understand the power of this vampire and overestimate the strength and prevalence of Pentex.

If you're this upset about Pentex you should consider your play style and build better decks that can deal with it.

EDIT: My best argument is "Rescue/Remove Pentex or I'll transfer out".

Messages.Author: thelonius reloaded
Messages.Body:
In those years, having tupdog/rock cat/war ghoul/shambling pay hard to rush you was a very good thing.

On pentex: if you fear pentex, play pentex to contest (even 3 on 90 cards if needed). Play smaller vampire around the big one to remove it (chimerstry is also stealth). Explain politely your point of view to other players and try to convince them.

But if you play vampires like Una, Arika, Stanislava, Enkidu, or any possible turbo star vampire, you somehow deserve a pentex.

Lurking in the underground of Bologna, Italy

Messages.Author: Mewcat
Messages.Body:
> DJHedgehog wrote:
>
> EDIT: My best argument is "Rescue/Remove Pentex or I'll transfer out".
>
This is good but you need a more nuanced position. There is a good chance your grand prey wants you to xfer out as you are putting no pressure on prey and basically just a pool sac making prey win. You have to try to figure out if this is the case and if so make the following deal: remove pentex or I will wall up as hard as possible.

You do have to keep in mind that if this doesn't work you are now in a weak bargaining position with your grand predator, who most likely wants you to be a pool sac.

It is very complicated.
